title: Explain one supplied achievement with bounded progress and honest missing art
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md and your frozen export contract in docs/PILOT100_UI_CONTRACTS.md before coding. Implement only your owned leaf module using installed React/TypeScript/testing dependencies. Export the exact named component and readonly props/types from index.tsx; keep module-local styles and tests inside that directory. Do not import an unmerged A/B task, edit App.tsx/shared barrels/manifests/task metadata or silently change another contract. This is controlled recipient-safe presentation, not an authority or complete application. Authority state/capabilities and semantic callbacks are supplied; no Firebase/native/store/network calls, secret caching, clock-driven game transitions, asset generation or fabricated success. Use original neutral-frost chrome, semantic HTML/keyboard access and honest unavailable media/provider states. Overlay leaves supply content to the separately composed modal host; do not claim global focus blocking in a content-only leaf. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, credentials, cloud deployment or budget changes. Preserve concise handoff, observed validation/failures and unknown costs under the benchmark policy. Render badge-detail glass content using supplied catalogue/progress only. Unknown progress/time remains unknown. No reconciliation of contradictory achievement22 or local event processing; no fabricated art,predicate or unlock date. Own only apps/client/src/pilot100/achievement-detail/; provide index.tsx exporting AchievementDetail, AchievementDetailProps and any named local types documented for B040. This task consumes part of A046; do not double-count it as a second implementation of that broad work. Run scoped React tests/lint/typecheck and node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; report actual results and unresolved application integration.
acceptance: Known progress is accessible; invalid/zero-target/unknown progress does not divide by zero or claim completion.
Locked details do not show an invented unlock date and missing art stays explicit.
Reduced motion suppresses glow motion while title,description and close remain available.
Exact frozen export/readonly props are implemented and scoped lint/typecheck/meaningful React tests plus node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full pass; only owned files change.
